<thought>We need to create an ML-ready dataset from the provided polymorph JSON, applying advanced feature engineering, normalizing, and splitting 80/20. The tool `prepare_tabular_dataset` will generate the necessary files (train and test CSVs) in the specified output directory. After that, we will create a metadata JSON file that lists the feature names and the paths to the train and test files, and then return the path to this metadata file.</thought>
<action>prepare_tabular_dataset</action>
<action_input>{
    "polymorphs_json_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/2_batch_retrieve_sulphide_polymorphs_trial_1/polymorph_data.json",
    "output_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_3/oxide_ml_dataset",
    "target_property": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "feature_engineering": "advanced",
    "test_split": 0.2,
    "normalize": true
}</action_input>
